summary.method: producing receipt by object identity (overlay sha256 == surviving copy at a successful receipt's -o path); pinned dependency sha256 vs the object the final closure loads; declaration-level comparison of each stale version (L187_Compare); L187_Refs for direct references of the module's constants (type or value) to differing constants; raw cones from NNH_L942/L943
summary.caveat: direct references only: a constant identical by declaration may unfold to a changed constant. The definitive check is the replay: a module rebuilt against the closure's objects that is declaration-identical to its overlay object shows the overlay object's terms typecheck in the closure environment.
